fermions.description: One standard fermionic pair a_1^+, a_1^-.

mixed_commutators.boson_fermion: [b_j^s, a_1^σ] = 0 for all j and s,σ in {+,-}

kappa.label: κ
kappa.description: Odd central symbol used by the inhomogeneous extension.

K.label: K
K.description: Even central identity; excluded from the basis.

basis.ordering_convention: PBW: κ < [odd: k ascending, pp, pm, mp, mm] < [even: H_1,...,H_{n+1}; E_2del{k}_p; E_del{i}_del{j}_pp; E_del{i}_del{j}_pm; E_2del{k}_m; E_del{i}_del{j}_mm; E_del{i}_del{j}_mp] (K=1 is excluded)

references: Frappat et al. (2000), Dictionary on Lie Algebras and Superalgebras
